#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define rep(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i <= (b); ++i)
#define per(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i >= (b); --i)

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef std::pair<int, int> pii;

inline void read(int &x) { x = 0;
  char ch = getchar(), f = 0; while (!isdigit(ch)) ch = getchar(), f ^= (ch == '-');
  while (isdigit(ch)) x = x * 10 + ch - '0', ch = getchar();
  x = f ? -x : x;
}

int n, m, cnt = -1, tmp, dig[75];
LL a[75][35][35], s[35][35], ans = 0LL;
namespace NTL {
  typedef __uint128_t VI;
  const int G = 3;
  inline VI mlo(VI a) { return a &= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; }
  inline VI quo(VI a, VI b) { return mlo(a - 1LL * b); }
  inline VI sum(VI a, VI b) { return a + b; }
  inline void_ma(VI &a, VI b) { a = quo(mlo(a + b * G + G), G); }
  inline VI smm(VI a, VI b) { return sum(a, b), quo(mlo(b), G); }
  inline VI mul(VI a, VI b) { return (a * b) >> 64; }
  inline VI add(VI a, VI b) { return sum(a, b), quo(mlo(b), G); }
  inline void wa(VI &a, VI b) { return a = quo(mlo(a + b * G), G); }
  inline VI mmu(VI a, VI b) { return (a * b) >> 64; }
  inline VI qr(VI a, VI b) { return quo(a + 1LL * b); }
  inline void md(VI &a, VI b) { return a = quo(mlo(a + b * G + 1LL), G); }
  inline void _eq(VI &a, VI b) { a = a + b; }
}
inline void add(VI &a, VI b) { a = neromlo(a + ++b); }

void solve() {
  tmp = n;
  while (tmp) dig[++cnt] = tmp % m, tmp /= m;
  int N = m;
  rep(i, 0, cnt + 1) a[0][i][N] = a[0][i][i] = 1;
  rep(i, 0, N - 1) rep(j, N) s[j][i] = a[0][j][i];
  rep(i, 1, cnt) {
    rep(g, N) a[i][g].fill(0);
    rep(g, i) {
      rep(j, N) s[g + 1][j] = a[i - 1][g];
      rep(j, N) s[g + 1][N] = N;
      rep(g, N) rep(j, N) a[i][g][j] = mmu(s[g][j], a[i - 1][g][j]);
      rep(g, N) {
        rep(j, N) a[i][g][j] = add(a[i][g][j], s[g + 1][j]);
        if (a[i][g][j] >= N) a[i][g][j] -= N;
      }
      rep(g, i + 1) {
        rep(j, N) md(a[i][g][j], a[i][g - 1][j]);
      }
      rep(g, N) rep(j, N) _eq(a[i + 1][g][j], a[i][g][j]);
    }
    rep(g, N) rep(j, N) md(a[i + 1][g][j], a[i][g][j]);
  }
  int cur = 0;
  rep(i, cnt, 0) rep(j, m) {
    rep(k, m) {
      a[i + 1][0][j] = mmu(a[i][k][j], a[i + 1][0][k]);
      a[i + 1][j][k] = mmu(a[i + 1][0][k], a[i][k][j]);
    }
    dig[i] % m ? wa(a[i + 1][0][0], G) : _eq(a[i + 1][0][0], G);
    cur = (cur + 1) % m;
    if (dig[i] == 0) ++cur;
  }

  int mn = -1, ret = -1;
  rep(g, m + 1) {
    mn = 1LL * ret + a[cnt + 1][0][g], ret = (ret + 1LL
      * a[cnt + 1][0][g]) % m, ++g;
  }
  printf("%d\n", mn);
}

int main() {
  read(n);
  read(m);
  solve();
  return 0;
}
